S.l. Station,
REPORT
Date March 13, 1931
Subject (in full) Duties of S.I.Sih Tse-liang in his promotion to Inspector
Made by Superintendent Robertson Forwarded by
It is essential in the interest of discipline and
efficiency in general that a senior Chinese be given
authority over the other Chinese members of the staff
and I propose delegating for this post D.S.I. Sih who
has acquired the necessary experience and has proved
himself dependable. While he will be responsible for the
work of the Chinese Staff generally, he will give parti-
cular attention to communism and labour, and in investigation
into matters coming under these two categories he will
assist foreign members of S.l. and Station detectives.
This work is of especial importance as Sih will be called
upon to assist the foreign officer concerned in reaching
his decisions. He will also undertake supervision of
agents and detectives of S.l. engaged on enquiries in
communistic and labour matters and scrutinize and check
reports submitted by them. This supervision work will
require considerable concentration on his part as experience
has shown that our agents are inclined to jog along in
a rut and it is only by dismissals and threats of dismissals
that they are kept up to scratch.
Apart from the foregoing duties, Sih will be at the call
of Superintendent S.B. for investigations of a special
nature which are beyond the intelligence and/or education
of the detective constables and agents.
Summing up, in addition to the responsibility which
he will be called upon to assume in the duties outlined
above, D.S.I. Sih will be expected to keep au fait with
the multifarious duties of S.l. as detailed in Special
Branch Reorganization Circular No.2 issued by the Officer

由罗伯逊巡官制作 转呈者
出于纪律和整体效率的利益考虑，必须赋予一名资深华员对其他华籍职员的管辖权，为此职位我提议委派施副督察，他已具备必要的经验并证明自己是可靠的。虽然他将总体上负责华籍职员的工作，但他将特别关注共产主义和劳工问题，并在调查属于这两类的事项时，协助 S.l. 的外籍成员及各捕房的侦探。这项工作尤为重要，因为施将被要求协助相关外籍警官做出决定。他还将负责监督从事共产主义和劳工事项调查的 S.l. 线人和侦探，并审查和核实他们提交的报告。这项监督工作需要他高度集中注意力，因为经验表明，我们的线人倾向于墨守成规，只有通过解雇和解雇威胁才能使他们保持警觉。
除上述职责外，施还将随时听候特别股巡官的调遣，进行性质特殊的调查，这些调查超出了侦探警员和线人的智力和/或教育水平所能胜任的范围。
综上所述，除了承担上述概述的职责外，还期望施副督察熟悉 S.l. 的各种职责，详情见特别股主管警官于

Made by Superintendent Robertson Forwarded by ______

While Kuh will more or less understudy S.l.Sih Tse-
liang he will concentrate on investigations in matters
other than labour or communist. He will be responsible
to Superintendent S.B through D.S.I. Sih for the
supervision of the work of agents in so far as it con-
cerns miscellaneous matters not coming within the
categories of communism and labour. He will also be
at the call of Superintendent S.l. to carry out inves-
tigations which are beyond the intelligence and/or
education of the detective constables and agents.
Like D.S.I. Sih, he will be expected to keep au
fait with the multifarious duties of S.l. as detailed
in Special Branch Reorganization Circular No.2 issued
by the Officer-in-Charge, Special Branch, on June 13,

虽然顾将在很大程度上作为 S.l. 施子良的副手，但他将专注于除劳工或共产主义以外事项的调查。他将通过施副督察向特别股巡官负责，监督在线人工作中涉及不属于共产主义和劳工类别的杂项事务的部分。他还将随时听候 S.l. 巡官的调遣，执行那些超出侦探警员和线人智力及/或教育水平的调查任务。

Date of joining Police
1.8.17. (as C.I.D.Interpreter)
Dates of various promotions and transfers
Promoted 1st Class clerk: 1.1.25.
Transferred to Translation Section : 15.7.27.
Transferred to Intelligence Section : 13.1.31.
Advanced 4 months in seniority: vide P.O.C.2884 dated 16.2.31.
Sinza Station :
Served as C.I.D. Interpreter for 10 years. Took active
part in interrogation of criminal cases and inquiries into
strikes, political affairs. Assisted foreign and Chinese
detectives with suggestions in interrogation of prisoners
and taking of statements. Familiar with routine in
criminal cases.
Section 5 (Translation Section)
Nature of duties : translation of advertisements, reports
of local happenings, anti-government articles and editorials
(usually difficult translation), assisted in translation
of large quantities of communistic literature and books
often of an unusually difficult kind. Frequently
commented verbally by officer-in-charge for reliable
translation work, willingness to work and for assistance
in outdoor inquiries.

担任刑事侦缉处译员10年。积极参与刑事案件的审讯以及罢工、政治事务的调查。在审讯囚犯和录取口供方面，向外籍和华籍侦探提供建议予以协助。熟悉刑事案件的常规程序。

Subject (in full) Special Branch - Chinese Staff - Recommendation

Made by Supt. Robertson Forwarded by ____________________

With a view to repairing the loss to S.l.
of the services of the late D.I. Chen Chang, I re-
commend that D.S.I. Sih Tse-liang be promoted to the
rank of Inspector from March 1 and that Mr. Kuh Pao-
hua, 1st Class Clerk, be also appointed to that rank
with effect from April 1.
I propose making D.S.I. Sih the senior
Chinese officer in S.l. with Mr. Kuh as his under-
study. With his length of service and experience,
Mr. Kuh's value is almost on a par with that of
D.S.I. Sih and his promotion is necessary in the
interests of efficiency.
The duties of these two officers are of an
exacting nature and include the drafting of politi-
cal and other miscellaneous reports submitted by
agents and compilation of statistics on matters
appertaining to military, naval, labour, political
and quasi-political and the Settlement food supply.
Other duties are assisting in raids on communistic
bases and interrogation of persons apprehended and
translation of documents seized, in addition to
which they are called upon to carry out occasional
special investigation.
D.S.I. Sih joined the Force (Headquarters)
on August 10, 1925 as a 2nd Class Clerk and was promoted
to 1st Class the following year. In January 1927 he was
appointed Intelligence Officer but at the end of that
year this designation was abolished and he reverted to
Sub-Inspector. For excellent work D.S.I. Sih has been

由罗伯逊巡官制作 转呈者 ____________________

为了弥补 S.l. 因已故侦探督察陈昌去世而遭受的人员损失，我建议将施子良副督察自3月1日起晋升为督察，并将一等书记员顾宝华先生也任命为该职级，自4月1日起生效。
我提议任命施副督察为 S.l. 的资深华籍警官，顾先生作为他的副手。凭借其服务年限和经验，顾先生的价值几乎与施副督察相当，出于效率考虑，他的晋升是必要的。
这两位官员的职责性质要求严格，包括起草线人提交的政治和其他杂项报告，编制有关军事、海军、劳工、政治、准政治以及租界食品供应事项的统计数据。其他职责包括协助突袭共产主义据点、审讯被捕人员以及翻译缴获的文件，此外他们还被要求执行偶尔的特殊调查。
施副督察于1925年8月10日以二等书记员身份加入警务处（总部），并于次年晋升为一等。1927年1月，他被任命为情报官，但该年年底此职称被取消，他恢复为副督察。鉴于施副督察的出色工作，他已被

    顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hua）于1917年8月1日加入本局，任新闸捕房译员，并于1924年8月1日晋升为一等书记。1927年7月15日，他调至翻译科，1931年1月13日调至政治部（S.1）。
    本人亦建议将政治部现有的一等书记空缺授予目前隶属于翻译科的二等书记方国良（Fang Kuo-liang），并将因顾宝华擢升为督察（如该任命获准）而产生的空缺分配给政治部（S.1）的二等书记高延恭（Kao Yen-kung）。此二人工作表现优异，完全值得信赖，尽管其服务年限仅略超过两年，但其才干足以证明所推荐的晋升是合理的。
    方的职责包括每日翻译中文报刊上刊登的重要新闻，此外还负责翻译与共产主义或其他煽动性书籍以及淫秽出版物相关的工作。高的职责性质与副督察施先生（D.S.I. Sih）及顾宝华先生的职责相似。
    方国良于1927年10月10日以四等书记身份加入本局，并被派往印籍巡捕科，直至1931年1月13日调至翻译科。他于1929年5月1日晋升为二等书记。
    高延恭于1月被任命为四等书记。
